journey.name: Discover and open a game
journey.description: Verify the Discover screen loads its game sections and that a game can be opened and dismissed. Runs logged out (Discover does not require authentication).

actions.action: Verify the Discover screen is shown with at least one section such as "Popular Games" or "Upcoming Games"
Wait until game cover images appear in the carousels
Tap the first game cover shown on the screen
Verify a game detail screen is shown with a game title and a back arrow
Verify the Discover screen is shown again
